hypothesis: Replacing the composite recovery objective with the per-record relative-L2 frame term will align gradients with aggregate_relative_l2 while preserving finite four-GPU optimization and current-data bindings.

single_conceptual_change.name: training_objective_alignment
single_conceptual_change.active_term: mean per-record relative L2 over selected exact stored frames
single_conceptual_change.unchanged: dataset, model, trainable prefixes, optimizer rates, adaptive sampler, schedule and train-only epoch gate

primary_metric: finite smoke updates with total loss equal to frame relative L2 and every disabled loss component equal to zero
failure_signal: Any binding mismatch, nonzero disabled component, total/frame mismatch, non-finite gradient, OOM, missing checkpoint or validation/test_id read blocks the full run.

bindings.contract_tests: selected relative-loss and full-support tests passed

rollback: Preserve the r2 epoch-0 checkpoint and all r2 evidence. Do not launch the full r3 run if smoke acceptance fails.
